_help: Direct (one-to-one) messages, and where people last read a chat. Messages after someone's lastRead time show as unread for them; without a lastRead entry everything before the demo start counts as read. Chat names: '<projectId>:project', '<projectId>:doc:BRD' (any document type), or 'dm:<number>' for the direct conversations below, counting from 1.

messages.body: Nusrat apa, quick one: on the cash count screen, do accountants enter each note denomination, or just the total?
Each denomination. Habib bhai says the auditors check the notes by denomination.
Okay, I will size the SRS for that. It adds one table to the matching service.
Can we do a 15-minute call after the BRD sign-off to plan the SRS?
Apa, I will upload the paper form scan today. Some fields are handwritten in Bangla, is that okay?
Yes, that is fine. The intake agent reads Bangla.
I will run the analysis as soon as it is there.
Shuvo, the UAT-1 retest passes on build 1.1 in Chrome. Still checking on the branch laptops.
Great, thanks Tania. Tell me if the Bangla font breaks on the old laptops.
